BiblicalUsage: Jaroah is named once, in the genealogy of Gad, the son of Gilead and the father of Huri. He stands in the long line of the tribe east of the Jordan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the tribes beyond the river as carefully as the tribes within it, and Jaroah is remembered.
